Container.Name: immich-server
Container.Overview:
Immich is a high-performance, self-hosted photo and video management solution. This is the main "immich-server" service (it runs both the API and microservices workers) from the official Immich `docker-compose.yml` and provides the web UI on port 2283.
This container depends on the "immich-postgres", "immich-redis" and "immich-machine-learning" containers. All four containers MUST share the same user-defined Docker network (named "immich" in these templates) so that Immich can reach them by container name. Start order: immich-postgres and immich-redis first, then immich-machine-learning, then immich-server.
The DB_PASSWORD set here MUST match POSTGRES_PASSWORD in the `immich-postgres` container.
Container.Requires: Requires the immich-postgres, immich-redis and immich-machine-learning containers to be running on the same custom Docker network ("immich", create it by running `docker network create immich`).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Immich web interface and mobile app API.

Config.Name: Upload / media location
Config.Description: Where Immich stores uploaded photos and videos (thumbnails, originals, etc). Equivalent to UPLOAD_LOCATION in the compose .env file. Point this at an array share with enough space, e.g. /mnt/user/photos/immich.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Hostname of the Postgres container. Must equal the Name of the postgres container (immich-postgres) and both must be on the 'immich' network.

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: Postgres username. Must match POSTGRES_USER in immich-postgres.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Postgres password. MUST match POSTGRES_PASSWORD in the immich-postgres container. Use only A-Za-z0-9 characters.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: Postgres database name. Must match POSTGRES_DB in immich-postgres.

Config.Name: Redis host
Config.Description: Hostname of the Redis/Valkey container. Must equal the Name of the redis container (immich-redis) and both must be on the 'immich' network.

Config.Name: Machine learning URL
Config.Description: URL of the machine-learning container. Must use the Name of the ML container (immich-machine-learning) on the 'immich' network. Set to 'false' to disable ML entirely.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Optional timezone, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam or Etc/UTC. Affects timestamps shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Localtime
Config.Description: Read-only host clock mount, as in the compose file. Optional if TZ is set.
